Play How to watch Sharks vs. Mammoth: TV channel and streaming options for November 14
 By Data Skrive Nov. 14, 2026 1:45 pm EST Updated Share article 
 The NHL schedule on Saturday features a matchup between the Utah Mammoth (10-8-2) and the San Jose Sharks (8-11-2), starting at 9 p.m. ET at Delta Center and broadcast on ESPN+. The Mammoth rank seventh and the Sharks 12th in the Western Conference.
 How to watch San Jose Sharks vs. Utah Mammoth
 Venue: Delta Center
 Time: 9 p.m. ET
 Streaming: ESPN+ (Sign in on ESPN+ with your Fubo account) 
 TV: ESPN+
 Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. 
 San Jose vs. Utah odds
 Puck Line: Utah -1.5 (+129), San Jose +1.5 (-160)
 Favorite Moneyline: Utah -193
 Underdog Moneyline: San Jose +157
 Total: 6.5

 Total Under Odds: -126

 Stats to know
 Clayton Keller has put up 25 points in 20 games (five goals and 20 assists).
 Karel Vejmelka has a goals-against average of 3.0, and a .879 save percentage (46th in the league).
 Over 19 games played this season, Macklin Celebrini has recorded23 points (1.1 per game), with eight goals and 15 assists).
 Yaroslav Askarov has given up 44 goals (3.1 goals-against average) and compiled 371 saves with an .894 save percentage (27th in the league).
